ireland-ring-of-kerry-touring-day.title: Ireland · Ring of Kerry Touring Day
ireland-ring-of-kerry-touring-day.slogan: A 161 km loop out of Moll’s Gap
ireland-ring-of-kerry-touring-day.story: Atlantic edges and Irish touring rhythm. A 161 km loop that starts and ends near Kenmare, about 3 h 06 of riding. On the way it passes Waterville coast and Kerry cliffs. Moll’s Gap is the high point. The passes are the reason to go.

scenicChapters.title: Ring of Kerry
scenicChapters.narrative: For 12 km this is Ring of Kerry, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Ring of Kerry
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 17 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

ireland-ring-of-kerry-touring-day.storyWas: Atlantic edges and Irish touring rhythm.
